details.title: Master Services Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

details.parties_quote: Sterling Care Network Inc., a Texas corporation having its principal office at 500 Main Street, Houston, Texas 77002 ("Sterling"); and AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation having its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, New Jersey 08540 ("Vendor").

payment_source.quote: Sterling shall pay USD 270,000 in total in monthly instalments, within thirty (30) days of receipt of each invoice.

details.services_summary: Data engineering and analytics services to improve patient scheduling and clinic utilisation.

liability_cap.basis: fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim
liability_cap.quote: Each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

insurance_requirements.quote: Vendor shall maintain, throughout the term, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 per claim.
